application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: No late applications. BA Fine Art portfolio due 31 Aug 2026. Final NBT date 3 Oct 2026. R100 for SA/SADC applicants, R300 for other international applicants.

aps_rule.notes: Faculty Points Score (FPS): English plus the best 5 other subjects, each scoring its percentage (below 40% scores 0), out of 600. Life Orientation excluded. Required subjects must be among the 5. Science counts Maths and Physical Sciences twice (out of 800); Health Sciences adds NBT scores (out of 900). The weighted score (WPS) adds a disadvantage factor the learner cannot calculate. Technical Maths never replaces Maths; Technical Sciences never replaces Physical Sciences.

courses.name: Bachelor of Business Science in Actuarial Science
courses.notes: Band A (guaranteed): FPS 500. Band B (likely admission): WPS 525+. Band C (SA redress categories only, EDU only): FPS 475-479. NBT AL & QL: Upper Intermediate or above; applicants with English FAL need Proficient for AL & QL. Transfers into Actuarial Science not permitted.

courses.name: Bachelor of Business Science in Actuarial Science (Extended - EDU)
courses.notes: Education Development Unit (EDU/ADP) route: only South African citizens/permanent residents in targeted redress categories (disadvantage factor above 1.0). Band C FPS 475 (printed range 475-479; mainstream Band A is FPS 500). Offered extended (5 years) or augmented (standard 4 years with support); same degree at graduation. UCT may also offer EDU places to applicants below mainstream requirements whose NBT results show potential. NBT AL & QL: Upper Intermediate or above; applicants with English FAL need Proficient for AL & QL. Transfers into Actuarial Science not permitted.
